title: fix(post): refuse waterjet posting until the jet records exist
body:
## What changed

This PR takes option 1 of the issue. It refuses waterjet posting by name until the jet records (#1882) and the waterjet laws (#1885) exist.

- The post gate (`verification_report_by`) refuses each unsuppressed waterjet operation. The new clause is in `crates/app/src/posting_waterjet.rs`. The refusal names the missing items: the standoff height, the jet on/off records, the pierce dwell records and the waterjet laws.
- A user post that declares `serves = ["waterjet"]` goes through the same gate. It writes no NC file.
- The stock simulation skips waterjet operations, as it skips wire cuts (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_waterjet.rs`). The nozzle does not go into the dexel model or the stock playback.
- The program sim refuses its verdict by name: "waterjet stock removal is not judged". The post gate shows this on its visible not-judged line.
- The path notes say that the jet and dwell records are not implemented. They also give a note for a pierce on the kerf ring when the lead-in is zero.
- The waterjet page:
  - shows the zero lead-in consequence;
  - shows the compensation choice as "In control" (no G-code words);
  - gives each tab row its own name ("Tab 1 position").
- Decision file: `docs/decisions/3637-waterjet-safety.md`. It also records that the operation does not model corner slow-down, taper or kerf lag.

## Cause

The waterjet operation has no standoff height. Its CL has no jet on/off record and no dwell record. No law refused it. A user post that served waterjet got a path with the nozzle tip at the sheet top. The stock sim used the nozzle as a milling cutter, and no note said that it does not judge waterjet.

## Note on the first attempt

The first attempt failed `post_not_judged::not_judged_with_no_generator_verdict_blocks` two times. Its waterjet clause sent back the generic `program_ops` error. The sim clause already reports that error, so the gate named one fault two times. Now the waterjet clause adds nothing when the program list cannot be read.

## Tests

Pins (`crates/app/tests/waterjet_profile.rs`):
- `waterjet_post_gate_names_the_missing_safety_records`
- `waterjet_user_post_cannot_bypass_the_safety_refusal`
- `waterjet_stock_verdict_is_refused_by_name`
- `waterjet_nozzle_is_absent_from_stock_playback`
- `waterjet_verification_reports_the_unjudged_operation`
- `waterjet_zero_lead_in_reports_the_pierce_on_the_kerf_ring`
- `waterjet_safety_refusal_omits_suppressed_operations_and_empty_documents` (control: green before and after)

Pins (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/waterjet_ribbon_tests.rs`):
- `waterjet_compensation_uses_a_plain_control_label`
- `waterjet_tab_position_rows_have_unique_names`
- `waterjet_zero_lead_in_names_the_part_edge_pierce`

Existing pin for the duplicate error: `post_not_judged::not_judged_with_no_generator_verdict_blocks`.

Mutation checks:
1. I put back the old `posting.rs`, `stock_sim.rs` and `waterjet/emit.rs`. Six app pins failed. The control passed. I restored the files. All 13 tests passed.
2. I put back the old `Err(why) => return vec![why]` arm. `not_judged_with_no_generator_verdict_blocks` failed with `left: 2, right: 1`. I restored the arm. The test passed.
3. I put back the old `waterjet_page.rs`. The three UI pins failed. I restored the file. The pins passed.

Original author gate runs (base `f2aa981b5`):
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 323 steps, 0 failed. The watchdog stopped the `ui build (--no-run)` step after 15 minutes with no output (slow box). I built the UI tests with cargo. Then I ran `--only "ui suites"` again: 9 steps, 0 failed (lib, boundary, boundary_picks, contour_dxf_sketch, sinker_setup, tap_hand, theme_example, theme_files, waterjet_tool).
- The quick plan included `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `catalog_groove_part_off`, `post_not_judged` and `waterjet_profile`. All passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base f2aa981b5`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- After the clippy fix (`.expect_err` in two tests), `waterjet_profile` ran again: 13 passed.

## Review fix verification (2026-11-24)

The review requested screenshots only. The PR head stays `92c452b54089449b281adff1f81c88d8776607ed`.
No source change or new pin was needed. The worktree is clean.

The three existing UI pins failed with the parent waterjet page. All three passed after restoration:
- `waterjet_compensation_uses_a_plain_control_label`
- `waterjet_tab_position_rows_have_unique_names`
- `waterjet_zero_lead_in_names_the_part_edge_pierce`

Commands on this final head:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **RED**, 332 steps; 331 passed after build-cache recovery. The UI lib step failed. It reported 1,581 passed, seven failed, and eight ignored. All seven failures report the unavailable graphics adapter. The 13 waterjet tests and eight UI integration suites passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **GREEN**.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: **RED**, 103 steps; one unexpected failure, zero stalls, 32.3 minutes. Five registered expected failures were accepted by the gate.
- Heavy failure: `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`, at `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:157`. The path counts were `(4688, 4660, 1980)`. This review round changes no code. No change to that test is in scope.
- `app suites: example_catalog`: 39 passed, four ignored in quick. Its heavy step also passed.
- `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: one passed each.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test golden_cl`: 34 passed, including the waterjet golden.

Both gates started with `upstream/main` at `9adabbb84ce8ae89decbf5453270bacc139f9efd`.
Another process advanced that shared ref to `8be002085c989c4399a243dbd535865effa054ef` during heavy.
The merge-base stayed `f2aa981b51a3453428fb294c6c71c575a0178ef6`, so the selected diff stayed the same.
The gates did not trial-merge that later main. No hardware GPU run was possible on this host.
The failed steps are recorded here. No unrelated repair was made.

## Goldens moved

None. The quick plan ran the example catalog suites, and they passed. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changed. The waterjet path notes changed text. No golden records these notes.

## Screenshots

Before: parent `f2aa981b51a3453428fb294c6c71c575a0178ef6` waterjet page.
After: reviewed head `92c452b54089449b281adff1f81c88d8776607ed`.
Both use the same egui harness state: control compensation, zero lead-in, and two tab positions.
The captures render the real page fields and font atlas with a temporary CPU renderer. This host has no GPU adapter.
The temporary capture code was removed. No source file changed in this review round.
The PNGs exist only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The links use its immutable commit.

## Not exercised

- Physical machine validation was not run. The gate results above describe the software checks.
- No shipped post serves `Kind::Waterjet`, so no shipped program changes.
- No live app run. The UI evidence uses egui_kittest and the CPU captures linked above. A GPU adapter is unavailable.

## Overlaps

Open PRs #2992, #2993 and #2999 change `crates/app/src/posting.rs`. They change other items (the `agie` module, `Posted`, `post_script_as`). This PR changes `verification_report_by` and adds one module line. They touch the same file but different functions. The PR that merges second refreshes. This PR merges cleanly with the current `upstream/main`.

Changelog: Waterjet Profile operations are refused at posting by name until the jet records and standoff height exist, and the stock simulation reports them as not judged instead of cutting with the nozzle.

Fixes #3637
